method: Inspected the original publishers' YouTube title, channel, publication-date and description metadata exposed by the web reader. For each GPU review, also inspected GamersNexus's original written adaptation, its video-date note and its tested model. No reposts or third-party performance summaries were used as evidence.
accessLimit: Direct YouTube watch-page reads returned the title and footer; indexed original YouTube descriptions provided the channel, exact date and disclosures. Playback, embedding permission, availability in each region and the current in-player paid-promotion label were not tested.
consumerRule: Show the component-only label, tested model, original publication date and limitations beside each prebuilt video. These are historical component reviews, not current-price advice or reviews of the linked complete PCs. Load a YouTube player only after the visitor clicks; retain the original watch link if embedding fails.
